description: Search the articles published on Fileion (blog posts and Fileion News) by title. Returns up to 10 articles per page, newest first, with the topic, author name, date and Fileion page address. The article text is not returned; it is on the page.

query.description: Part of the article title, e.g. "download manager".

type.description: Only blog posts or only news.

name: search_articles
title: Search articles
